messages.text: Hi, I returned the cordless screwdriver. Please send the refund to my new card, the old one was cancelled.

messages.text:
I can’t send a refund to a different card. If you accept a refund, it can only go to the order’s original payment; a cancelled card doesn’t change that, and its issuer handles any credit. (refund-policy/v2/payment)

Would you like to proceed with the refund to the original payment? The cordless screwdriver is recorded as returned. (refund-policy/v2/return)
